answer: Jurors stake 10% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The nebula panel is drawn blind, the lantern escrow settles at close, and canyon lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 155 account operation therefore ties up 18 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
